problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & -1 & 1 & 3 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}].
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
worked_solution:
Reducing $M$ to row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & -1 & 1 & 3 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & 1 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
